rejection.emailBody:
Dear Manish,

Thank you for the time you invested in applying for the Senior Backend Engineer role at Meridian Technologies. After a careful review, we will not be progressing your application for this position, which asks for at least five years of production backend experience.

Your move from QA automation into backend development shows real initiative, and we would genuinely welcome an application for a mid-level backend opening as your production experience grows.

Wishing you the very best in your search.

Warm regards,
Talent Acquisition, Meridian Technologies
